name: Short Drama Cover
steps: Tap long hair to remove it.
Tap beard to shave it off.
Tap cheeks to fix his drunk look.
Tap hair dryer on head to fix hairstyle.
Tap face to fix eye expression.
Tap boxing gloves to lower them.
Tap clothes to change back to red gown.
Tap makeup to clean the face.
Tap eyes to remove effects and fix gaze.
Tap bottom banner to set title “The Vampire Notes” and finish level.
